description: Every update gets GitHub's auto-merge through platform-automerge and is merged once a code owner in .github/CODEOWNERS approves it and the image workflow (the image built and its smoke test run) and the test workflow pass; both run on every pull request whatever it changes. What is merged this way reaches a release on its own through the weekly release workflow

lockFileMaintenance.description: Most of Gemfile.lock is gems nothing in Gemfile names, such as the faraday adapters and the oauth helpers. Renovate only moves those when a named gem asks for it, so the lock is rebuilt once a month to keep them current as well

packageRules.description: tumblr_client 0.8.6 pins faraday ~> 1.0, whose JSON middleware calls JSON.parse with arguments json 3 no longer takes. The test fails with json 3, so json stays on 2.x until tumblr_client or faraday moves
